messages.subject: Problems with implementing  actionButton/isolate()
parts:
/I'm trying to get to grips with actionButton and am having problems understanding how to implement the variations on anything much more complicated than Winston's(?) example

My app is based on MLB baseball players
The ui offers 
a) A selectInput of players (id player)
b) A uiOutput which is a sliderInput(id season) based on the range of years the selected player played in
c) An action button id goButton



The server.R includes

 output$yearRange <- renderUI( {
   processing based on input$player
   sliderInput()
   })
   
 
 theData <-reactive( {
    processing inc webscraping based on input$player
and input$season[1],input$season[2] resulting in
data.frame(playerdf) and some variables
info=list(playerdf,some variables)
return(info)
})
several renderPlot,renderText,renderTable e.g.
output$plot1 <- renderPlot( {
 df <- theData()$playerdf
 print(ggplot(df,.....))
})
 
I have 3 questions
a) If I do not want any graphs to appear initially where do I need to put 'if (input$goButton == 0) return()'

b) I only want any processing to occur after I have selected the player and the range of years so I need to use the isolate option. Where should I be placing this. I am getting the "unexpected symbols" with my attempts. When I select a new player, I do want the renderUI to perform

c) How does actionButton + isolate differ from submitButton and when is it appropriate to use one or the other
